model:
rachana: 1
sutra: fiscal-position
version: 2
description: 
match: { kind: fiscal-position, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Economics · Fiscal position", id: "$.FISCAL_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Economy", bind: "$.ECONOMY_NAME" }
  - { label: "Debt / GDP", bind: "$.DEBT", fmt: "pc1" }
  - { label: "Net lending / GDP", bind: "$.BALANCE", fmt: "pc2", tone: "sign", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Revenue / GDP", bind: "$.REVENUE", fmt: "pc1" }
  - { label: "Expense / GDP", bind: "$.SPENDING", fmt: "pc1" }
  - { label: "Military / GDP", bind: "$.MILITARY", fmt: "pc2" }
panels:
  - id: ratios
    kind: hbar
    title: "Central government, % of GDP"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.RATIOS"
    label: "ITEM"
    value: "VALUE"
    fmt: "pc1"
  - id: debtPath
    kind: line
    title: "General government gross debt, % of GDP"
    area: right
    rows: "$.DEBT_PATH"
    x: "YEAR"
    y: "DEBT"
    fmt: "pc1"
  - id: balancePath
    kind: line
    title: "Net lending / borrowing, % of GDP"
    key: "F3"
    rows: "$.BALANCE_PATH"
    x: "YEAR"
    y: "BALANCE"
    fmt: "pc2"
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and licence"
    area: right
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
keys: { F7: "link($.ECONOMY, 'economy')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
